g = nx.Graph()
g.add_nodes_from(range(15))

for r in range(4, len(g.nodes)):
    for subset in itertools.combinations(g.nodes, r):
        subgraph = g.subgraph(subset)
        if len(subgraph.nodes) == r and len(subgraph.edges) == 0:

    else:
        continue
    break
